query: SELECT gl.played_at, kv.value AS round1_data FROM game_logs gl JOIN game_log_participants glp ON glp.game_log_id = gl.id, jsonb_each(gl.game_record->'actions'->0->'players') AS kv WHERE gl.game_id = 'game-003' AND glp.nickname_snapshot = '아이큐' AND kv.value->>'nickname' = '아이큐' ORDER BY gl.played_at DESC
